ground_truth.main_content:
Our AI-Powered Platform: Empowering Small Businesses to Thrive with AI

Unlock the Power of AI for Your Business

An AI-driven suite of tools designed to help businesses grow, streamline operations, and enhance customer engagement. By leveraging our forward-thinking, AI-centric approach, You can spend more time working on your business instead of in it.

Learn More

Business App Pro

Five AI-assisted solutions to help local businesses thrive in a global market

Empower your local business to flourish in the competitive marketplace with Business App Pro, a suite of AI-infused tools designed to streamline operations while enhancing customer experience. From the initial stages of prospecting to the final steps of payment processing, this comprehensive solution covers every aspect of your business journey.

Learn More

Powerful AI that helps get you found on local search
Claim, update, and fix business listings on over 300 directories and websites that control local search.

Learn More

Unleash AI-powered tools to supercharge your online reputation
Monitor and manage all aspects of your online reputation, including listings, reviews, mentions and more.

Learn More

Powerful AI tools to boost your social media presence
Grow your fanbase on social media, find real-time leads and share relevant content across all your social channels.

Learn More

The ultimate communication hub for local businesses
AI-assisted web chat lead capture, SMS messaging,  - centralizing communication into a shared inbox, helping businesses capture website leads and more.

Learn More

Create captivating, campaigns in minutes using AI
Reactivate cold leads, engage new ones, and boost sales with this easy to use email and SMS marketing automation software.

Learn More

Local SEO increases visibility of your business by driving your website to the top of local listings.
Get customers In your doors.

Learn More

Convert more customers by ensuring that your business is ready for the digital age and ready to start transacting on-line today.

Learn More

Reach more customers through digital advertising campaigns that span across search engines and social media.

Learn More

FEATURES FOR YOUR BUSINESS

Capture leads and communicate in a shared team Inbox and CRM hub with appointment booking, email and SMS marketing automation, review management, SEO, and more!

AI-Assisted Lead Capture
Collect leads from your website and turn them into happy customers

CRM with Integrations
Centralize all your customer data in the CRM, with integrations to bring contact data from outside systems into one place

Inbox Messaging Hub
Collaborate with your team on communicating with customers from a unified Inbox for SMS, Web Chat, Facebook and Instagram

Meeting Scheduler
Easily book meetings with clients; both in-person or via digital conferencing with Google Meet or Zoom

SEO, Social Media & Reputation
Show up higher wherever people are searching for your products and services, with tools for improving your social media presence, SEO and Reputation

Easy Analytics Reporting
Easily understand how your business is performing on Google, and across the web

Integrations
Customer data can sync with Zapier, Google, Facebook and more

Automations
Automate key workflows for your business – like sending a review request when a job is completed!

Powered by AI
AI-assisted lead capture and content generation: email campaigns, sms, social media

Email and SMS Marketing
Connect with your audience at scale, with smart campaigns that can be sent via email and SMS

Mobile App
[Coming Soon] to iOS and Android

Follow The Customer Journey To Success

The way consumers shop for goods has transformed with the introduction of eCommerce and online reviews. Consider the last time you made a purchase. Where did you make this purchase? If it wasn’t online, you were likely influenced by reviews or listings found online. The customer journey has changed and every business owner needs to understand the implications of this transformation.

Learn More

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does Get Local offer to small businesses?
A: Get Local offers a full suite of digital tools including CRM, Local SEO, AI automation, email marketing, SMS campaigns, and reputation management—all in one platform.

Q: Is Get Local only for businesses in Wichita?
A: While based in Wichita, KS, Get Local serves small businesses nationwide.

Q: Does Get Local offer support and on-boarding?
A: Yes! We provide full on-boarding, training, and ongoing support to help you get the most out of our platform.

Q: Can I manage all my marketing in one place with Get Local?
A: Yes! Our all-in-one platform includes tools for email, SMS, CRM, social media, SEO, reviews, automation, and even web chat—so you can run everything from one dashboard.

Q: Is Get Local easy to use for non-tech-savvy business owners?
A: Absolutely. We designed the platform to be simple and intuitive. Plus, our local support team is here to help if you ever get stuck.

Q: How quickly can I start seeing results?
A: Many businesses start seeing results within the first 30 days, especially with improved lead capture, local SEO visibility, and automated follow-ups.
